### Analysis for FRD

#### 1. Pattern Recognition
The prior trend from 2026-03-30 (low at 629.28) to 2026-06-02 (high at 760.40) was a **strong, almost vertical uptrend** — a classic flagpole. Since that peak, the price has begun a shallow pullback (current close 741.75), retracing only a fraction of the rally. The retreat has not yet formed clear, straight-line boundaries from the swing highs and lows provided. No two parallel/converging trendlines can be anchored with confidence; the limited number of swings after the high prevents definitive upper and lower trendlines. At this stage, the structure is best described as a **tentative bull flag under construction**, but it lacks sufficient touch points to meet the criteria for a verifiable classical pattern. A flag would require a downward-sloping consolidation with at least two high and two low boundary points, which are not yet present.  
**Current stage:** Early consolidation within a strong uptrend — unconfirmed flag.

#### 2. Signal Confidence: 3/10

The low win rate and lack of supporting overbought/oversold divergences make this a low-confidence signal.
